overview: The Roband ST350A Sycloid Toaster, can toast up to 350 slices of bread per hour, with a 'cool touch' exterior and intelligent, energy efficient design.

The innovative & cleverly designed Sycloid motion indexes the toast through the machine, making it possible to achieve outstanding toasting results. It produces even, golden brown colouration across both sides of the toast.

An automatic power-save mode conserves energy during quiet periods by scaling back energy consumption. The intelligent autosense feature detects when a new slice is placed in the machine & automatically prepares the machine to toast the bread. The heat setting in this mode is balanced & optimised for quick recovery to ensure minimal user impact.
Diners can easily see when their toast is ready with the cut-away sides of the warm toast chute which is LED illuminated.
A user-friendly & reliable speed controller allows adjustment of the toasting time to account for different types of bread to be toasted.

Featuring robust stainless steel elements, a brushed stainless steel exterior with safe external touch temperatures, a slide-out crumb tray & a hinged top cover allowing easy access to clean the inside. The toast movement racks are also easily removable & are machine washable.
Patron & staff safety is paramount & the Sycloid toaster has been designed with safe external touch temperatures.
